name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  unit:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Argument handling of scripts/run.sh
        shell: bash
        run: bash tests/run_test.sh

  action:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Install a pinned CLI and run a command
        uses: ./
        with:
          command: version
          cli-version: 1.868.0
      - name: wmill is on PATH at the pinned version
        shell: bash
        run: |
          out="$(wmill version)"
          echo "$out"
          grep -qx 'CLI version: 1.868.0' <<< "$out"
      - name: Install only (no command)
        uses: ./
        with:
          cli-version: 1.868.0

  # Runs only where the WMILL_TEST_TOKEN secret exists (not on fork PRs).
  # Use a token for a disposable test workspace; the command is read-only.
  live:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      HAS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WMILL_TEST_TOKEN != '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: List scripts of the test workspace
        if: env.HAS_TOKEN == 'true'
        uses: ./
        with:
          command: script list
          token: ${{ secrets.WMILL_TEST_TOKEN }}
          workspace: ${{ vars.WMILL_TEST_WORKSPACE }}
          base-url: ${{ vars.WMILL_TEST_BASE_URL || 'https://app.windmill.dev' }}
          cli-version: 1.868.0

name: 'Windmill CLI'
description: 'Install the Windmill CLI (wmill) and optionally run a wmill command, e.g. sync push, against a Windmill workspace.'
author: 'Windmill Labs'
branding:
  icon: 'wind'
  color: 'blue'

inputs:
  command:
    description: 'Arguments passed to wmill, for example "sync push --yes". Split on whitespace and never evaluated by a shell (no quotes, variables or globs). Leave empty to only install wmill.'
    required: false
    default: ''
  token:
    [REDACTED] 'Windmill API token. Store it as a secret. When set, --token, --workspace and --base-url are appended to the command.'
    required: false
    default: ''
  workspace:
    description: 'Windmill workspace id. Required when token is set.'
    required: false
    default: ''
  base-url:
    description: 'Base URL of the Windmill instance. Set it for self-hosted instances.'
    required: false
    default: 'https://app.windmill.dev'
  cli-version:
    description: 'Version of the windmill-cli npm package. Pin it (e.g. 1.868.0) for reproducible CI; "latest" tracks new releases.'
    required: false
    default: 'latest'
  node-version:
    description: 'Node.js version used to run wmill.'
    required: false
    default: '24'
  working-directory:
    description: 'Directory in which to run wmill (the folder holding wmill.yaml).'
    required: false
    default: '.'

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
      with:
        node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version }}

    - name: Install wmill
      shell: bash
      env:
        WMILL_CLI_VERSION: ${{ inputs.cli-version }}
      run: npm install -g "windmill-cli@${WMILL_CLI_VERSION}"

    - name: Run wmill
      if: ${{ inputs.command != '' }}
      shell: bash
      working-directory: ${{ inputs.working-directory }}
      env:
        WMILL_COMMAND: ${{ inputs.command }}
        WMILL_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.token }}
        WMILL_WORKSPACE: ${{ inputs.workspace }}
        WMILL_BASE_URL: ${{ inputs.base-url }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/run.sh"

# Windmill CLI action

Installs the [Windmill](https://www.windmill.dev) CLI (`wmill`, npm package [`windmill-cli`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/windmill-cli)) and optionally runs one `wmill` command against a workspace. It replaces the `npm install -g windmill-cli` and `wmill sync push ...` steps of the git sync CI workflows in the [Windmill docs](https://www.windmill.dev/docs/advanced/git_sync).

## Deploy a repository to a workspace on merge

```yaml
name: Deploy to Windmill
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: windmill-labs/windmill-cli-action@v1
        with:
          command: sync push --yes --skip-variables --skip-secrets --skip-resources
          token: ${{ secrets.WMILL_TOKEN }}
          workspace: my-workspace
          base-url: https://app.windmill.dev
          cli-version: 1.868.0
```

## Install only

Leave `command` empty and call `wmill` in later steps:

```yaml
      - uses: windmill-labs/windmill-cli-action@v1
        with:
          cli-version: 1.868.0
      - run: wmill sync pull --yes --workspace my-workspace --token "$WMILL_TOKEN" --base-url https://app.windmill.dev
        env:
          WMILL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WMILL_TOKEN }}
```

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | no | | Arguments passed to `wmill`, e.g. `sync push --yes`. Empty: only install `wmill`. |
| `token` | no | | Windmill API token; store it as a secret. When set, `--workspace`, `--token` and `--base-url` are appended to the command. |
| `workspace` | when `token` is set | | Workspace id. |
| `base-url` | no | `https://app.windmill.dev` | Base URL of the instance; set it for self-hosted Windmill. |
| `cli-version` | no | `latest` | `windmill-cli` version. Pin it so CI does not change with each release. |
| `node-version` | no | `24` | Node.js version used to run `wmill`. |
| `working-directory` | no | `.` | Directory in which `wmill` runs (the folder holding `wmill.yaml`). |

`command` is split on whitespace and passed to `wmill` as separate arguments. It is never evaluated by a shell, so quotes, `$VARIABLES`, `$(...)` and globs are passed literally. For arguments that contain spaces, use the install-only mode and call `wmill` in a `run` step.

## Notes

- With `token` set, the action passes `--base-url`, which makes `wmill` use only the given token and workspace and ignore any stored CLI profile.
- `sync push` writes every local file selected by `wmill.yaml` to the workspace. Use a dedicated token and the `includes`/`excludes` settings of `wmill.yaml` ([sync docs](https://www.windmill.dev/docs/advanced/cli/sync)) so the repository only manages the paths it owns.
- Works on Linux, macOS and Windows runners (steps run in `bash`).

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Unit tests for scripts/run.sh: a stub `wmill` on PATH records its argv,
# one argument per line, so each test asserts the exact command line.
set -euo pipefail

root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$work/bin"
cat > "$work/bin/wmill" <<'STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$WMILL_ARGV_FILE"
STUB
chmod +x "$work/bin/wmill"
export PATH="$work/bin:$PATH"
export WMILL_ARGV_FILE="$work/argv"
unset GITHUB_ACTIONS

failures=0
run_case() { # name, expected argv (newline-separated), env assignments...
  local name="$1" expected="$2"; shift 2
  rm -f "$WMILL_ARGV_FILE"
  if ! (cd "$work" && env -u WMILL_COMMAND -u WMILL_TOKEN -u WMILL_WORKSPACE -u WMILL_BASE_URL "$@" bash "$root/scripts/run.sh" >/dev/null); then
    echo "FAIL $name: run.sh exited non-zero"; failures=$((failures+1)); return
  fi
  local actual; actual="$(cat "$WMILL_ARGV_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo '<wmill not called>')"
  if [ "$actual" = "$expected" ]; then echo "ok   $name"; else
    echo "FAIL $name"; echo "  expected: $(printf '%q ' $expected)"; echo "  actual:   $(printf '%q ' $actual)"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
}

run_case "command with token appends explicit flags" \
"sync
push
--yes
--workspace
my-ws
--token
t0k
--base-url
https://windmill.example.com" \
  WMILL_COMMAND="sync push --yes" WMILL_TOKEN=t0k WMILL_WORKSPACE=my-ws WMILL_BASE_URL=https://windmill.example.com

run_case "no token passes the command only" \
"version" \
  WMILL_COMMAND="version" WMILL_BASE_URL=https://app.windmill.dev

run_case "extra whitespace and newlines are separators" \
"sync
pull
--yes" \
  WMILL_COMMAND=$'  sync\tpull \n --yes  '

# Shell syntax must reach wmill as literal text and never run.
run_case "no shell evaluation" \
'$(touch
PWNED)
;
echo
`id`
*
$HOME' \
  WMILL_COMMAND='$(touch PWNED) ; echo `id` * $HOME'
if [ -e "$work/PWNED" ]; then echo "FAIL command substitution was executed"; failures=$((failures+1)); else echo "ok   no file created by command substitution"; fi

# Empty command: success, wmill not called.
rm -f "$WMILL_ARGV_FILE"
if (cd "$work" && WMILL_COMMAND="   " bash "$root/scripts/run.sh" >/dev/null) && [ ! -e "$WMILL_ARGV_FILE" ]; then
  echo "ok   empty command installs only"; else echo "FAIL empty command"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi

# Token without workspace: error, wmill not called.
rm -f "$WMILL_ARGV_FILE"
if out="$(cd "$work" && WMILL_COMMAND="sync push" WMILL_TOKEN=t0k WMILL_BASE_URL=https://x.example bash "$root/scripts/run.sh" 2>&1)"; then
  echo "FAIL token without workspace should exit non-zero"; failures=$((failures+1))
elif [ -e "$WMILL_ARGV_FILE" ]; then
  echo "FAIL token without workspace called wmill"; failures=$((failures+1))
elif [ "$out" != "::error::The 'workspace' input is required when 'token' is set." ]; then
  echo "FAIL token without workspace: unexpected message: $out"; failures=$((failures+1))
else echo "ok   token without workspace is rejected"; fi

# Exit code of wmill is propagated.
printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexit 7\n' > "$work/bin/wmill"
set +e; (cd "$work" && WMILL_COMMAND="sync push" bash "$root/scripts/run.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1); code=$?; set -e
if [ "$code" = 7 ]; then echo "ok   wmill exit code is propagated"; else echo "FAIL exit code: expected 7, got $code"; failures=$((failures+1)); fi

if [ "$failures" -ne 0 ]; then echo "$failures failure(s)"; exit 1; fi
echo "all tests passed"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Runs `wmill <command> [--workspace W --token T --base-url U]`.
# Inputs come from the environment (set by action.yml):
#   WMILL_COMMAND    arguments for wmill, split on whitespace, never evaluated
#   WMILL_TOKEN      optional API token; when set, WMILL_WORKSPACE is required
#   WMILL_WORKSPACE  workspace id
#   WMILL_BASE_URL   instance base URL
set -euo pipefail

command_text="${WMILL_COMMAND:-}"
token="[REDACTED]}"
workspace="${WMILL_WORKSPACE:-}"
base_url="${WMILL_BASE_URL:-}"

if [ -z "${command_text//[[:space:]]/}" ]; then
  echo "No command given: wmill is installed, nothing to run."
  exit 0
fi

# Word-split without a shell: no command substitution, variable expansion or globbing.
args=()
IFS=$' \t\n' read -r -d '' -a args <<< "$command_text" || true

if [ -n "$token" ]; then
  if [ -z "$workspace" ]; then
    echo "::error::The 'workspace' input is required when 'token' is set."
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$base_url" ]; then
    echo "::error::The 'base-url' input is empty."
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ -n "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" ]; then
    echo "::add-mask::$token"
  fi
  # Explicit flags, so no stored CLI profile on the runner is used
  # (--base-url requires --token and --workspace).
  args+=(--workspace "$workspace" --token "$token" --base-url "$base_url")
fi

exec wmill "${args[@]}"
